reason: Confirmed in CONTEXT l.3349-3365 (W2 v4, 01:02Z). Under S3, BASE = exp78b (v3 (5)). With C+, W2 v4 (2)(i) sends exp83a before (iii) exp80a. W2a went to exp85a (probe 50, 05:02Z), and 4 of the 5 submits for 28 Sep are used (poll header 07:02:42Z; 47-50 PENDING). W2b is therefore the last slot of the day, and 'move to W3' is not a separate slot. exp80a could still take the one allowed W4 DIV step (v3 (8)) at 00:05Z on 29 Sep. It would read ~07:30-07:50Z. exp84a needs exp80a strictly above exp78b (two strict steps), and S6 bans a DIV-only file after 01:45Z, so under the registered rules exp84a cannot be decided. Two corrections: (1) 'never' is slightly overstated. W4 AMEND 2 (5) allows 'one DIV step under S3' after 02:00Z with the user's yes. That contradicts S6, which was written in the same entry, and should be resolved in the same line. (2) The logged CI latency band is 9.4-10.9 h, so exp83a at 00:06Z reads by ~11:00Z, not strictly ~10:45Z. That is still before the 29 Sep 12:00Z card. The swap is value-positive. CI files are info-only for the finals (04:31Z card), so reading exp83a later costs no finals candidate, and in W4 it is exactly the AMEND 2 (1)-1 FULL file, so it takes no extra planned slot. exp80a is finals-eligible and non-CI. Caveats: the branch is unlikely (P(S3 and C+) ~0.05-0.1, since both 47 and 48 must read '+'). exp84a's lab prior is weak and negative (0 TP / +4 FP), though the lab has been wrong in sign on DIV knobs. The swap only makes sense if it is logged pre-score, before the 47 read (terminal from ~06:58Z; still PENDING at 07:02Z).
fix: In the W2b TABLE v5 line, pre-score and quoting the last PENDING header: 'Under S3 (exp78b '+', disp78b >= disp78a, 46 not '-', exp80a dummy PASS), exp80a takes W2b at 12:00Z ahead of any CI stack, whatever the CI and 50 reads are. It is non-CI, so it needs no wait for 50. Under S3 with C+, the CI stack (exp83a, or exp83f if exp80a reads strictly above exp78b) goes to W4 00:06Z as the FULL file, reading by ~11:00Z. Under S3, push the exp84a (4cb1e47b) dummy at T1 so that it has PASSED before 00:00Z. S6 stands: exp84a goes only in W4 before 01:45Z. W4 AMEND 2 (5) 'one DIV step under S3' after 02:00Z is struck, or limited to exp80a itself if it could not go earlier.' S3's tie case (disp78b == disp78a, where v3 (5) makes exp78a BASE) stays as it was registered.
realistic_gain: Only in the S3 and C+ branch (P ~0.05-0.1). It keeps the exp84a decision available: one extra finals-eligible DIV read. It also moves the exp80a read from 29 Sep ~07:40Z to 28 Sep ~19:45Z, which gives the W4 build time. Expected public effect ~+0.0000-0.0002 overall, and private unknown (division volume on other embryos). Cost ~0: the CI stack still reads before the 12:00Z card, and CI files are info-only for the finals.
